backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing authentication with fixed admin credentials (ID: 919708075648, password: 979142876085), user profiles, product management with barcode support, and order management with payment methods (UPI/COD) and status tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the implementation of a 'Forgot Password' option linked to admin mobile number 919708075648, with high confidence and test ID REQ-3.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including AdminGuard which displays admin credentials and includes a 'Forgot Password' section with contact information (mobile 919708075648) for password reset assistance.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including primary, secondary, accent, and sidebar styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with PWA meta tags, app icons, camera permission description for barcode scanning, and manifest link for Maa Bhawani General Store application.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons (192x192, 512x512, 180x180), standalone display mode, and branding for Maa Bhawani General Store & Banking Point.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first for API calls, with automatic cache cleanup and offline fallback support.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, checkout, order confirmation, store details, admin, billing, and admin settings pages.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authorization component that verifies admin access, displays a login dialog with admin credentials visible, includes comprehensive error logging, and features a 'Forgot Password' section with contact information (mobile number 919708075648) for password recovery assistance.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: Form component for adding new products with fields for name, category, price, barcode, and image upload. Includes validation, duplicate barcode checking, and upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays a table of all products with images, details, and delete functionality. Includes loading skeletons and confirmation dialogs for product deletion.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: Camera-based barcode scanner component using Quagga2 library loaded from CDN. Features flash toggle, haptic feedback, beep sounds, scan cooldown, and permission handling.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Displays searchable table of all generated bills with view, print, and CSV export functionality. Includes dialog for viewing individual bill details.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: Printable bill template component displaying shop header, bill details, itemized list, and total. Formatted for 80mm thermal printer width.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Fixed floating button in bottom-right corner that initiates a phone call to the shop number (9142876085).
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Side drawer displaying cart items with quantities, prices, and total. Includes swipe-to-close gesture, clear cart, and checkout navigation functionality.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: A horizontal scrollable filter component that displays category buttons and highlights the selected category.
Displays an informational alert about the store's delivery policy: free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary class component that catches rendering errors and displays a detailed error UI with reset and home navigation options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying store information, contact details with phone and map links, delivery info, and copyright with caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with store logo, navigation links, cart button with item count badge, and login/logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that combines Header, Footer, CallUsButton, and renders children in a flex container with gradient background.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: Form component for mobile recharge orders with operator selection, mobile number input, and amount field that submits recharge requests to the backend.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays payment QR code image with the total amount and step-by-step UPI payment instructions.
frontend/src/components/PhoneNumberSetup: Empty component file with no content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Card component displaying product image, category badge, name, price, and an add-to-cart button with authentication check.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Grid layout displaying products with category filtering, loading skeletons, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including products, cart, orders, recharges, bills, payments, and admin functions using the actor from useActor hook.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color variables using OKLCH color space, touch-friendly utilities, thermal printer styles for 80mm receipts, and barcode scanner animation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard with tabs for managing products, orders, recharge orders, and bills, displaying revenue statistics and order status management with real-time updates.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page for configuring shop slogan with live preview using a mock bill template, protected by AdminGuard.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: Point-of-sale billing interface supporting barcode scanning (camera or manual entry), cart management with quantity controls, customer details input, and bill generation with print functionality.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout page component that handles order placement with customer details (name, phone, address, distance), payment method selection (UPI/COD), delivery fee calculation, and form validation before navigating to order confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page component displaying store banner image, mobile recharge section, and product grid with category browsing functionality.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that displays order success message, order ID, payment method, and shows either UPI QR code for payment or cash-on-delivery instructions based on selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Store information page displaying contact details, location with Google Maps embed, delivery policy (free within 1km, ₹20/km beyond), store hours, and available services.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations, and typography/container-queries plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting pending feature requests including admin authentication fixes (credentials reset to 919708075648/979142876085), session timeout resolution, forgot password functionality, and automatic customer notifications for order status changes.
